intro: Report to Hadrec is a Horde military dispatch directing champions within the Sepulcher to consult Silverpine's field commander. Following Apothecary Renferrel and Bethor Iceshard's investigation into the Scourge presence in Lake Lordamere, High Executor Hadrec coordinates the martial preparations required to storm Fenris Isle. It marks the transition from magical reconnaissance to direct tactical warfare.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec. He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.
To aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...
